adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when `safeParse` fails, but it is never reset to `false` when the user corrects the emails and retries `handleAdd()` successfully. The only reset is in the Cancel button handler (`setIsInvalidEmail(false)`), not in `handleAdd` or mutation callbacks. This means the red warning can remain visible during a subsequent valid submission (until the dialog closes on success). The finding’s claim that it remains visible even after success is slightly overstated because `onSuccess` closes the dialog, but the core issue (stale flag on retry) is verifiable from the diff.
